3220-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1339-1832-5231-6772.description:

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Repeat.

813-1181-7166.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Sacrifice and Dose of Dawnglow from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

586-2906-5258-5618-6495.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
586-2906-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-2906-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4067-5078-7753-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Repeat

2744-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

2082-3490-5147-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.

Berta and Animation Module trigger.

1169-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1497-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

538-3490-4369-5231.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impact Tremors triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-2097-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1315-2366-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1315-2366-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2438-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

413-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-5617-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2511-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
2511-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4170-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-5256.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Inkling's power.
Repeat.

851-2457-4094-5794.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
851-2457-4094-5794.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1418-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}.
751-1418-3821.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

185-4293-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U}, returning Runic Repetition to your hand from your graveyard.

Cast Runic Repetition by paying {2}{U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5637-5642-5657--34.description:
Cast an Eldrazi with mana value 4, 5 or 6 from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Ulalek and Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability trigger twice, the Eldrazi cast triggers twice if it has a cast ability, Echoes of Eternity triggers once if the Eldrazi cast was colorless.
Resolve the first Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, the additional Ulalek's trigger, both Kozilek's Unsealing triggers, both Eldrazi cast triggers if it had one, and the Echoes of Eternity trigger if it triggered.
Resolve both Eldrazi cast triggers, if applicable.

Holding priority, activate two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, the additional Ulalek's trigger, both Kozilek's Unsealing triggers and any other abilities on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Kappa Tech-Wrecker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Kappa Tech-Wrecker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Kappa Tech-Wrecker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Resolve all Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 5 damage to any target for each trigger.

Resolve a Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Ratadrabik equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies with haste.

Let the Blood Artist triggers resolve.
Pay for the Nim Deathmantle trigger with {4}, returning Myr Moonvessel to the battlefield equipped with Nim Deathmantle.
Repeat.

"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Presence of Gond attachted to Captain of the Mists.
